mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 1679.0 as of t-2mo, indicating a recent decline from prior months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1650.0.
